LanguageData.FD_Designator_NoFireZoneExpandDesc: Mark cells that your turrets must not pick as an automatic target. You can still force-target anything inside the zone by hand - the zone only restrains the turret's own target search.
LanguageData.FD_Designator_NoFireZoneClearDesc: Remove cells from the no-fire zone.
LanguageData.FD_NoFireZone_ObeyGizmoDesc: While on, this turret will not pick an automatic target whose blast could reach the no-fire zone. Turn it off to let this one turret fire into the zone anyway - useful when you want a single gun covering a breach. Force-targeting by hand works either way.
LanguageData.FD_NoFireZone_FirstBlockMessage: A turret held its fire: its shells could land inside your no-fire zone. It will engage targets outside the zone normally, and you can still force-target by hand.
